Get hyper parameters from the regional model and climate variables

Source: R/full_local_regional.r
get.regional.params.Rd

Get hyper parameters from the regional model and the given climate variable values. Parameter set for regional analysis is re-parametrized to log-index flood (index flood for log-transformed specific discharges), alpha = log(scale/log.index.flood), and ksi = -0.5 + 1 / (1 + exp(-k)).

Usage

get.regional.params(clim, new.reg.coef = FALSE)

Arguments

clim

A data.frame containing the standardized climate variables.

new.reg.coef

Logical. If TRUE, uses updated regression coefficients (default = FALSE).

Value

A list containing the estimated means and standard deviations for log-index flood, alpha, and ksi.
